Official sources: [Codex pricing][cp], [models][cm], [release log][cl]; [Claude pricing][ap], [CLI models][cc], [fast mode][cf].
Descriptions below quote official excerpts; release links identify the base model (also for fast rows).

[^columns]: **1M** = one million tokens; rates apply separately to each token category.
    **Input**: new, uncached prompt/context tokens (including history and tool results).
    **Cached / Cache hit**: input tokens reused from a stored prompt prefix.
    **Output**: generated tokens, including billed reasoning/thinking tokens.
    **Burn: in / cached / out**: row rate ÷ baseline rate in the corresponding column (GPT-6 Luna for Codex; Haiku 5.5 for Claude).
    Example: 25 ÷ 2.5 = 10× input burn.
    Burn is calculated here, not a provider metric; credits and USD are not directly comparable.

[^codex]: [Standard-speed credit rates][cp]; no cache-write charge.
    API-key usage follows API pricing; credits alone do not determine included subscription usage.
    Fast: 2× credits; included usage is 2× for GPT-6.2, 2.5× for older models.
    GPT-6.2 Ultrafast: 6× included usage; purchased credits/PAYG 3× through 2027-02-28, then 6× from 2027-03-01 (Pacific time).

[^luna]: OpenAI: “focused, high-volume tasks” ([model guide][cm]).
[^terra]: OpenAI: “detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use” ([announcement][rt]).
[^sol]: OpenAI: “complex coding and agentic workflows” ([release log][cl]).
[^sol61]: OpenAI: “Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price” ([announcement][r61]).
[^sol62]: OpenAI: “our efficient, versatile model for everyday work” ([announcement][r62]).
[^astra62]: OpenAI: “our new frontier model for your hardest projects” ([announcement][r62]).
[^astra]: OpenAI: “reasoning and computer use” ([model guide][cm]).

[^claude]: [Anthropic API rates][ap]; [CLI aliases][cc] vary by version/provider.
    Minimum CLI versions: Haiku 5.5 2.1.293; Sonnet 5.5 2.1.284; Opus 5.5 2.1.280; Fable 5.2 2.1.321.
    Fable 5.1: select `/model claude-fable-5-1` (2.1.257+).
    Subscription fast mode uses usage credits; fast rows share base model descriptions and release dates.
    Cache writes cost 1.25× input (5m) or 2× input (1h).
    Haiku 5.5 prompts over 100K tokens cost 5× all rates.
    `opusplan` uses Opus for planning and Sonnet for execution.

[^haiku]: Anthropic: “For high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks such as classification, extraction, and routing” ([overview][haiku]).
[^sonnet]: Anthropic: “The best combination of speed and intelligence” ([overview][sonnet]).
[^opus]: Anthropic: “For long-running agentic coding and knowledge work” ([overview][opus]).
[^fable52]: Anthropic: “For demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work” ([overview][fable52]).
[^fable51]: Anthropic: “coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks” ([announcement](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-1)).
